_why: The controlled vocabulary for the tags an activity carries in its `wida` array (access-practice-lab/content/<band>/<Domain>.json). Activity tags are free text today; this file says what each recognised tag means, so coverage can be measured (tools/generate-language-page-tag-coverage.mjs) and new content can be held to one spelling. A tag is a Key Language Use when it starts with one of `klu`; it is a content-area tag when it equals an alias below (case-insensitive) or starts with one followed by a colon or dash. Anything else is a free-text can-do statement, which is fine and is not counted as a tag. Spellings other than `label` are counted as variants in docs/language-page/coverage-matrix.md. Adding an alias here is a content decision, not a code one.
